instruction: Go straight past the pool. Walk between the bar and chairs.  Stop when you get to the corner of the bar.  That's where you will wait.

steps.thought: I see a pool on the right and a bar area ahead. I'll move forward along the pool edge toward the bar and chairs.
The bar counter is visible ahead, slightly right of center, with chairs to its left. I'll advance toward it and then turn to reach its corner.
I'm facing the bar with chairs on my left. I need to pass between them, so I'll turn slightly right to clear the chairs and advance toward the bar's corner.
The bar is ahead on the left and the pool on the right; I should advance toward the bar's near corner, staying between the bar and the lounge chairs.
The bar is on the left and chairs ahead; I need to walk between them toward the bar's far corner. Move forward along the open path, then turn slightly left to reach the bar corner.
The bar is on the left and the chairs are just ahead; I need to pass between them and stop at the bar's near corner. I'll advance carefully toward the gap.
The bar is on the left with its corner just ahead-left, and chairs are to the right; I'm already between them. I'll advance slightly to reach the bar's corner, then stop.
